summary: Complete testing of Hotel del Pacifico features: Site admin login, Kamerprijzen (room prices) dashboard tab, public API room_prices, hotel website pages (Habitaciones/Tarifas), and FWorks portfolio inclusion. All features working correctly.

test_results.site_admin_login: PASS - Login with hotel@hoteldelpacifico.com / hotel123 works correctly, redirects to /mijn-site
test_results.kamerprijzen_tab: PASS - 'Kamerprijzen' tab appears in sidebar for hotel site_type, shows 3 room cards with editable fields
test_results.room_prices_display: PASS - Room prices displayed: Habitación Clásica $35, Habitación Superior $55, Suite Ejecutiva $85
test_results.room_prices_api_save: PASS - PUT /api/site-admin/config with room_prices field works correctly
test_results.public_api_room_prices: PASS - GET /api/public/site/hoteldelpacifico returns room_prices in config
test_results.habitaciones_page: PASS - /site/hoteldelpacifico/habitaciones shows dynamic prices ($35, $55, $85), no 'Precio próximamente'
test_results.tarifas_page: PASS - /site/hoteldelpacifico/precios shows dynamic prices ($35, $55, $85), no 'Precio próximamente'
test_results.fworks_portfolio: PASS - Hotel del Pacífico card present with correct info (Hotel & Restaurant, Santo Domingo, Ecuador)
test_results.background_images: PASS - Habitaciones uses habitaciones-bed.jpg, Tarifas uses tarifas-reception.jpg

seed_data_creation: Room prices already seeded: Habitación Clásica $35, Habitación Superior $55, Suite Ejecutiva $85
